doc: Monster script for Seagra, the group of six linked pieces (monster handles 24 to 29) of the p01 boss. Each piece shares a state machine through monster variables: it slams the ground with a dust ring, then goes limp while its boss-c map part is shown, and recovers with an electric shock effect once it has been hit or the partner is far away. Each piece refills its life every frame and only counts hits.
